content: कन्दलः, -लम् .²1 A new shoot or sprout; मयालब्धः पाणिर्ललितलवलीकन्दलनिभः <ls>U. 3. 40</ls>. .²2 Reproach, censure. .²3 The cheek, or the cheek and temple. .²4 A portent. .²5 Sweet sound. .²6 The plantain tree; कन्दलदलोल्लासाः पयोबिन्दवः <ls>Amaru. 48</ls>. .²7 Collection; <ls>U. 3. 11</ls>. .{@-लः@} .²1 Gold. .²2 War, battle. .²3 (Hence) War of words, controversy. .{@-लम्@} A Kandala flower; विदलकन्दलकम्पनलालितः <ls>Śi. 6. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 29</ls>.
